identifier_namespace: The Designation of Freeport Tax Sites (Solent Freeport) (No. 2) Regulations 2022 (SI 2022/973)
evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' Solent Freeport tax-site page states that the Navigator Quarter tax site was designated with effect from 14 October 2022 and that Freeport tax sites are recognised in law as geographical areas where businesses can benefit from tax reliefs to bring investment, trade and jobs. The Designation of Freeport Tax Sites (Solent Freeport) (No. 2) Regulations 2022 identifies the map entitled 'Navigator Quarter Tax Site', dated 8 June 2022, and states that the designated area is known as the Navigator Quarter Tax Site.
